lines.t: I heard a whisper in the silence,
A voice that broke the night apart,
It spoke of mercy and of guidance,
A flame igniting every heart.
The world is turning, all are yearning,
To find the truth beyond the veil,
The words are written, the seals are breaking,
The wind of heaven fills the sail.
Awake, awake, the trumpet’s calling,
Rise from shadows into grace,
The Voice is crying, hope is falling,
Light of judgment, Love’s embrace.
I see the storm before the sunrise,
The earth is trembling, skies unfold,
But in the chaos shines the promise,
A kingdom built of hearts made whole.
The broken lifted, tears are turning,
To rivers flowing from above,
The stone rejected now is burning,
A cornerstone of endless love.
Awake, awake, the trumpet’s calling,
Rise from shadows into grace,
The Voice is crying, hope is falling,
Light of judgment, Love’s embrace.
Every word is life and thunder,
Every truth is clear and pure,
Through the storm I will not wander,
For His promise shall endure.
The Voice in the light is shining,
Calling every soul by name,
The end is near, but love is binding,
Forever His truth remains.
